title: Find the 10-message cap on messages between sessions on the Mac
why: Sessions on the owner's Mac stop messaging each other after 10 turns until the owner speaks to them.
note: Owner ask ask-mw5a0ekdlv (page, 11:56 CST Nov 6). A search of claude-settings main 7975f6d8 found no cap in our code (triage 12:12 CST). Find the source (Claude Code changelog, binary, or a hook on the Mac) and whether a setting lifts it. Needs a Mac session to see the message.
